A wine-producing area. The [[Aes Sedai]] Embassy that [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]] had sent to [[Cairhien]] to escort [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] to the [[White Tower]] were staying with Lady Arilyn. [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] went to the palace and, detecting channeling inside, used Air and Fire to replicate [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]]’s eavesdropping trick on the inside, and heard that a wine from Arindrim was to be served to the Aes Sedai. {{Ref/book|6|25}}
